mapper.sql: SELECT goodsid, saleprice AS price, number, salestime AS sale_time FROM bus_sales WHERE isdelete = 0 AND IFNULL(order_status, 0) = 0 AND number > 0 UNION ALL SELECT goodsid, retailprice AS price, number, retailtime AS sale_time FROM bus_retail WHERE isdelete = 0 AND IFNULL(order_status, 0) = 0 AND number > 0

choose.when: SELECT HOUR(s.sale_time) AS label, IFNULL(SUM(s.price * s.number), 0) AS total FROM () s WHERE DATE(s.sale_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(s.sale_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY HOUR(s.sale_time) ORDER BY label

SELECT DAYOFWEEK(s.sale_time) - 1 AS label, IFNULL(SUM(s.price * s.number), 0) AS total FROM () s WHERE DATE(s.sale_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(s.sale_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(s.sale_time) - 1 ORDER BY label

SELECT DAY(s.sale_time) AS label, IFNULL(SUM(s.price * s.number), 0) AS total FROM () s WHERE DATE(s.sale_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(s.sale_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DAY(s.sale_time) ORDER BY label

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.sale_time, '%Y%m%d') AS label, IFNULL(SUM(s.price * s.number), 0) AS total FROM () s WHERE DATE(s.sale_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(s.sale_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(s.sale_time) ORDER BY label

SELECT MONTH(s.sale_time) AS label, IFNULL(SUM(s.price * s.number), 0) AS total FROM () s WHERE DATE(s.sale_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(s.sale_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY MONTH(s.sale_time) ORDER BY label

mapper.update: update bus_sales set number = number - #{number} where id = #{id} and isdelete = 0 and ifnull(order_status, 0) = 0 and number >= #{number}
